study_identification_part.si4_title: Contrasting Case-Control and Normative Reference Approaches to Capture Clinically Relevant Structural Brain Abnormalities in Patients With First-Episode Psychosis Who Are Antipsychotic Naive

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Evaluate whether baseline deviations from a normative reference in subcortical volumes better predict antipsychotic treatment response than raw volumes in antipsychotic-naive first-episode psychosis (FEP).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Partial correlations between raw volumes and treatment response (covariates: age, sex) and Pearson correlations between deviation scores (z) and response; differences in associations between raw vs deviation measures tested (caudate z = -2.17, P = .03; putamen z = -2.15, P = .03).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Negative deviations in caudate, putamen, and ventral diencephalon predicted better antipsychotic response, outperforming raw subcortical volumes.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Of 98 FEP patients, 36% showed extreme deviations. Case-control differences showed lower raw thalamus, hippocampus, amygdala, ventral diencephalon, and brainstem volumes in FEP. Yet deviation measures in caudate, putamen, and ventral diencephalon were more strongly associated with symptom improvement than raw volumes (significant difference in associations for caudate and putamen).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Single-site 3T Siemens Prisma acquisition (MPRAGE; SPACE); FreeSurfer v7.1.1 processing; BrainCharts/PCNtoolkit normative models calibrated with local HCs to handle site effects; bilateral regional volumes used.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Did not exclude cannabis users; chose age and sex (rather than TIV) as covariates for raw volume–response correlations; no quantitative NM performance metrics (e.g., EV/MSLL) reported for this cohort.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Scanner: 3T Siemens Magnetom Prisma with 20-channel head coil; MPRAGE TR/TE/TI=2400/2.22/1000ms; SPACE TR/TE=3200/56ms; 0.8 mm isotropic. Calibration approach keeps life-span curve shape fixed and adjusts intercept/scale per site.
